title: Udhaya
desc: Udhaya falls in love with Vasanthi, but realises that she is already engaged. Later, when he is wrongly framed for a crime, she strives to prove his innocence.

title: Adhibar
desc: Shiva arrives in Chennai from Canada and starts up a real estate business. However, things take a turn when he realises that he is being cheated by the people he trusts.

title: Vazha Vaitha Daivam
desc: Two families remain in a continuous state of conflict over a misunderstanding from the past. However, their rivalry takes an unexpected turn after their youngsters fall in love with each other.

title: Oru Melliya Kodu
desc: A deceased woman's husband becomes a suspect after her body goes missing from the morgue. The disappearance exposes a web of lies and deceit when things unravel.

title: Mettukudi
desc: A man pretends to be the son of a long-lost royal family to steal a precious sword. However, his plan runs into complications when the granddaughter of the sword's guardian falls in love with him.
